create_StyleGAN2Loss: create a StyleGAN2Loss instance with generator mapping, synthesis, and discriminator networks
run_G_generate_images: run the generator to produce fake images and latent styles from noise vectors
run_D_compute_logits: run the discriminator to compute real or fake logits for given images
accumulate_gradients_Gmain: accumulate generator main loss gradients by maximizing logits for generated images
accumulate_gradients_Dr1: accumulate discriminator R1 regularization gradients by computing gradient penalty on real images
